Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import ContentConfig, CrawlConfig, batch_scrape, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(content=ContentConfig(preprocessing_preset="aggressive"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    urls = ["https://example.com/article1", "https://example.com/article2"]
    result = await batch_scrape(engine, urls)
    print(result.completed_count)
    print(result.failed_count)
    print(result.total_count)

asyncio.run(main())
```
